aspirations: Make them admit what they sent you into.
Find out what the Hush does with the slabs it recovers.
entries.description: An outfit that boards silent ships, recovers or destroys what is aboard, and keeps it quiet. Nobody agrees whether the Hush is a company, a navy or something older.
entries.name: the Hush
entries.notes: The game's recurring hunter. Knows what to do with survivors.
entries.summary: Boards ships that went silent, recovers or destroys what is aboard, keeps it quiet.

aspirations: Be the first to read the glyphs.
Keep a dig, and the people on it, alive.
entries.description: A survey charter that digs the ancient ruins and catalogs glyphs nobody can read. Knows more than it admits.
entries.name: the Stratum
entries.notes: Relic Leaves can carry a Stratum seal.
entries.summary: Survey charter that digs the ancient ruins and catalogs glyphs nobody can read.

aspirations: Get back on the Lanes with your name clean.
Finish a delivery that was never finished.
Pay a crew back for what you cost them.
entries.description: A haulers' union whose crews know every Haven on the old trade routes. Ordinary freight lines carry slabs without knowing.
entries.name: the Lanes
entries.summary: Haulers' union whose crews know every Haven on the old trade routes.

aspirations: Tell the Choir what it is really worshipping.
Bring someone home from the order.
entries.description: One of the cults that speak of black books that answer prayers. It waited generations for a book to answer, and has never seen the Last Altar it sends Pilgrims to.
entries.name: the Choir
entries.summary: A cult of black books; waited generations for one to answer.

aspirations: Pay off a debt and fly free.
Find who is buying slabs, and why.
entries.description: The black market where slabs change hands. Links to the Hauler's quiet trade.
entries.name: the market
entries.summary: The black market where slabs change hands.
